decisions.reason: As a flagship extension of the firm's core cloud messaging capabilities, it still fits strongly with existing knowledge and R&D, although its lack of visibility since 2020 raises some chance of it being folded into a broader offer.

Document capture and recognition supports digital workflows but is less central to the firm's core messaging knowledge base, and the prolonged lack of visibility suggests resources may be better redeployed to stronger adjacent services.
This is a narrow feature tied to fax, an area that is close to the firm's legacy competence but strategically less attractive for future multichannel growth, making withdrawal likely.
Threat protection remains highly consistent with the firm's secure messaging position and absorptive capacity in security-related development, so retention is more likely than withdrawal.

Multi-engine virus scanning is closely related to the firm's email security infrastructure and can be improved through in-house learning, though it may increasingly be packaged as part of a broader security suite.
